signals.summary: Reco raised an additional $55 million in funding with participation from AT&T Ventures, Forestay, and Quadrille Capital, bringing total funding to $140 million.
signals.evidence: Reco, the leader in Agentic Security, today announced it has raised an additional $55 million including a strategic investment from AT&T Ventures and support from new investors Forestay and Quadrille Capital.

signals.summary: Reco provides an Agentic Security platform that discovers, governs, and secures agents and their operating environments across enterprise apps and AI ecosystems.
signals.evidence: Reco is the leader in Agentic Security. The Reco Platform secures agents and their operating environments where applications, identities, permissions and workflows converge.

signals.summary: AT&T participates as both a customer and a strategic investor in Reco.
signals.evidence: AT&T’s participation as both a customer and strategic investor reflects the need for security that follows agents across enterprise ecosystems.
signals.speaker: Ofer Klein
